reasoning: For a US ally to acquire nuclear weapons in 2025 would require either: (1) a current non-nuclear ally developing/acquiring operational nukes, or (2) a major geopolitical shift enabling this. Current non-nuclear NATO members and MNNAs lack the technical capability or political will to develop nukes in one year. While proliferation risks exist (Iran, North Korea), these aren't US allies. The timeframe is extremely short for any legitimate nuclear program. Historical precedent shows nuclear acquisition takes years/decades. No credible reports suggest imminent acquisition by any US ally.
